primary_sources.title: Daily News Sentiment Index
primary_sources.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco

primary_sources.title: Measuring News Sentiment
primary_sources.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco

source_facts: The official index is built from economic-news articles and exposed as a daily historical series that the product page says is updated weekly.

The current page offers one data workbook, chart CSVs and replication code; it does not identify an official archive of each weekly publication vintage or an exact historical publication timestamp series.

The primary paper studies consumer-sentiment nowcasts, monthly macro impulse responses and LASSO variable selection. For the S&P 500 it reports only that distributed news-sentiment lags can be selected by forecasting models.
sf_fed_daily_news_sentiment.why_not_ready: A zero-sign, change-sign, quantile, lag, moving-average or release-week rule would be a newly invented external-state hypothesis rather than the paper's fixed action. The weekly publication timing and historical vintage surface are also not pinned for a causal 2022-2026 join.

primary_sources.title: NYSE introduces closing auction imbalance analysis tool
NASDAQ Net Order Imbalance Data Files Will Be Available Via NASDAQ Historical TotalView-ITCH
The NASDAQ Opening and Closing Crosses

source_facts: The exchange messages expose a direct, causally timed buy or sell imbalance and indicative clearing information before the opening or closing auction.
The free NYSE analysis surface is limited to a trailing three months and the 1,000 largest daily closing auctions.
Full NYSE order-imbalance history from 2008 is a purchased TAQ product. Nasdaq NOII is supplied through subscription products and Historical TotalView-ITCH on T+1.

A US30, US100 or US500 book carrier would additionally require point-in-time constituent membership, exchange mapping, corporate-action-safe weights and a frozen cross-security aggregation, or separate DIA, QQQ and SPY exchange-feed histories.
us_equity_opening_and_closing_auction_im.why_not_ready: This is the strongest causal mechanism screened, but the complete 2022-2026 historical carrier is not available in the authorized public surface. A single-symbol, three-month, ETF-only or close-window approximation would change the mechanism and cannot justify a candidate gate or new sleeve.

primary_sources.title: List of Historical Margins by Name
An Empirical Analysis of Futures Margin Changes: Determinants and Policy Implications
primary_sources.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

source_facts: CME officially exposes daily historical margin tables for S&P 500, Dow Jones and Nasdaq-100 from 2020 through the present, plus public advisories and effective dates for changes.
CME states that performance bonds vary with product and market volatility, are recalculated at least daily, and margin calls require accounts below maintenance to return to initial margin.

The Federal Reserve study finds CME raises margins quickly after volatility spikes, equity-index margin changes are infrequent, and volatility changes are the consistent driver of whether margins change. It studies determinants and procyclicality, not a fixed next-return trading direction.
cme_equity_index_performance_bond_change.why_not_ready: The source is constructible, but the economic action is not. Margin changes are principally an endogenous response to the volatility state already observed by the market. Neither the exchange nor the primary study identifies whether a subsequent US30/US100/US500 candidate birth should be long, short, blocked, scaled or held differently. Choosing risk reduction after increases would reopen the closed volatility/risk/cap neighborhood without an independent return or loss channel.
